scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,blue "dotenv -e .env -- npm run dev -w @s3/api" "dotenv -e .env -- npm run dev -w @s3/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @s3/api && npm run build -w @s3/web && npm run build -w @s3/infra
scripts.test: npm run test -w @s3/api && npm run test -w @s3/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @s3/api && npm run lint -w @s3/web
